equity.level_reason: Educational attainment (SES) is the primary comparison and the gradient is described, but the endpoint values (12.2% vs 33.6%) are only set side by side, with no computed difference or ratio and no disparity framing, so the level is capped at 2.

level_alternative.reason: Education is itself a social determinant and the stratifier of the whole report, so the level-3 SDOH-exposure rule could apply if the stated endpoint gap (12.2% to 33.6%) is read as a quantified contrast.

ev.q: The percentage of adults who met these guidelines increased with increasing educational attainment

equity.equity_measurement: Education in at least three groups, from high school or less to bachelor's degree or higher; only the endpoint groups are given in the text, and intermediate values are in the figure only.
